summary: QA plan for gpt-copy-v8 covering backend Axum/sqlx behavior, mocked OpenRouter streaming and failure modes, frontend component coverage, Playwright smoke coverage, verification commands, and secret/artifact hygiene required by the approved project rules.

proposals.title: Backend API and persistence tests
proposals.summary: Add Rust tests around conversation creation/list/detail, message persistence order, invalid IDs, SQLite test isolation, and config defaults including OPENROUTER_MODEL fallback. Use temporary databases and run sqlx migrations in test setup.

proposals.title: Mocked OpenRouter SSE and provider failure tests
proposals.summary: Exercise streaming chat with a local mock provider so automated tests never call OpenRouter. Cover normal token streaming, 429, timeout, invalid JSON/chunk response, upstream disconnect, and client interruption without backend crashes or partial database corruption.

proposals.title: Frontend component test coverage
proposals.summary: Use component tests for chat layout, conversation sidebar, composer disabled/loading states, message rendering, error banners, and EventSource/SSE client state transitions using mocks instead of network calls.

proposals.title: Playwright smoke test
proposals.summary: Add one end-to-end smoke path that starts backend and frontend with local test configuration, opens the app, creates or selects a conversation, sends a prompt through mocked provider behavior, observes streamed assistant text, and confirms reload persistence.

proposals.title: Repository verification and hygiene checks
proposals.summary: Document and run the final verification set: Rust fmt/clippy/test, frontend lint/test/build, Playwright smoke, git ignored artifact check, and tracked-file secret scan for OpenRouter keys before any completion report.

risks.title: SSE tests can become timing-flaky
risks.impact: Streaming assertions may pass locally but fail under slower CI or worker environments.
risks.mitigation: Assert ordered semantic events and terminal states with bounded retries instead of fixed sleeps; keep mock provider deterministic.

risks.title: Automated tests may accidentally hit OpenRouter
risks.impact: Tests could consume quota, leak local configuration assumptions, or fail when network/provider quota is unavailable.
risks.mitigation: Make provider base URL injectable, force tests to use a local mock server, and fail tests when OPENROUTER_API_KEY would be used.

risks.title: SQLite state leakage between tests
risks.impact: Conversation/message tests may become order-dependent and hide persistence defects.
risks.mitigation: Use per-test temporary database files or isolated in-memory pools with migrations applied per test fixture.

risks.title: Frontend and backend contract drift
risks.impact: Component tests can pass while the real app fails due to mismatched API payloads or SSE event names.
risks.mitigation: Add at least one Playwright smoke path against the real Axum backend and keep shared API fixtures aligned with backend response shapes.

claims.title: Provider tests must be mocked
claims.summary: All OpenRouter success and failure QA should use a local mock because project rules forbid external provider calls from automated tests unless explicitly required.

claims.title: Verification must span both apps
claims.summary: Completion should require backend formatting, linting, build/tests, frontend lint/tests/build, Playwright smoke coverage, and tracked-file secret scanning.

claims.title: Streaming is the highest-risk behavior
claims.summary: SSE combines provider chunk parsing, client disconnects, persistence side effects, and UI state, so it needs backend integration tests plus one browser smoke test.

claims.title: Project rules preserved
claims.summary: The QA plan keeps OpenRouter calls server-side, treats OPENROUTER_API_KEY as a local secret, keeps .env ignored, and requires placeholder-only .env.example content.
